# cubepath_kubernetes_addon (Resource)

Manages a Kubernetes addon installation on CubePath Cloud.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) UUID of the Kubernetes cluster.
- `slug` (String) Addon slug identifier (e.g., cert-manager, ingress-nginx).

### Optional

- `values` (String) Custom Helm values as JSON string.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) Addon category.
- `description` (String) Addon description.
- `helm_chart` (String) Helm chart name.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the installed addon.
- `installed_at` (String) When the addon was installed.
- `name` (String) Addon display name.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace where the addon is installed.
- `status` (String) Current installation status.
- `version` (String) Installed version.
